text: I conclude, then, that the plea of having acted in the interests of a friend is not a valid excuse for a wrong action. For, seeing that a belief in a man's virtue is the original cause of friendship, friendship can hardly remain if virtue he abandoned.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
speaker: Laelius
reference: Treatises on Friendship and Old Age
location: Rome or his villa at Tusculum, Italy (presumed)
